purpose: Prevent specialists from executing with stale assumptions and propagate verified learning across the factory.
cycle_triggers: before any decision that depends on external facts, prices, laws, APIs, product capabilities or competitor state
after a task produces new evidence
after a blocker or failed test
after client feedback, payment, delivery or support evidence
at least once every seven days for active specialties even when no task completed
refresh_sequence: read canonical task, product contract, decision log and latest proof
identify assumptions whose freshness affects money, safety, legality, delivery or architecture
verify unstable claims against primary or authoritative sources
record source, checked_at, confidence, affected artifacts and expiry rule
update the knowledge sync bus and route changed conclusions to impacted specialists
invalidate superseded guidance instead of silently appending contradictions
done_rule: A cycle is not complete until new evidence is recorded or an explicit no-change refresh record exists.
